libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Start an EmbeddedServer on a random port by setting micronaut.server.port=-1, create the client against server.getURL(), and close both resources. Exercise built-in endpoints such as /health and configuration-sensitive behavior; avoid optional JDBC, discovery, or external-service integrations unless specifically tested.

deterministic_setup.reason: Micronaut Management is normally consumed as HTTP endpoints; the artifact does not include an HTTP server. https://guides.micronaut.io/latest/micronaut-health-endpoint-gradle-groovy.html
Tests need an HTTP client to call the embedded management endpoints. https://guides.micronaut.io/latest/micronaut-health-endpoint-gradle-groovy.html
Management endpoint results are JSON responses; the generated scaffold has no JSON HTTP codec. The repository’s Micronaut 5.1.13 HTTP test uses this module.

risks: Native-image verification must confirm the embedded server, client, and JSON serialization work together.
Do not add a Docker image: the core management endpoints have no mandatory external service dependency.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: Meaningful coverage requires exercising management endpoints through an embedded Micronaut HTTP server with JSON responses.
